name: contract-history-retention
goal: Rebuild complete source history without retaining full revision source state or corrupting shared-tree catalog measurement provenance

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Full 2873-revision reconstruction retained about 6 GB after only 42 revisions. A strengthened existing archive case additionally checks that two commits sharing a tree retain their own catalog measurement revision.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing archive case covered only two different trees and verified JSON/media, not the SQLite catalog measurement provenance. Extend that same case with an unchanged-tree commit and exact selected-revision assertions; keep one case.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing single archive case fails the selected-commit catalog provenance assertion at the committed unchanged-tree fixture. Harness retains the failed command, source/test corpus and assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Working repair now writes each full immutable snapshot before retaining compact summaries, streams persisted snapshots to SQLite, interns repeated ledger entries, and bounds source/registry/media caches. The same existing archive assertion passes with unchanged tests.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The paired immutable Harness record reruns the frozen existing archive case against the repair, with the original test corpus, assertion, command and runtime unchanged; selected-commit JSON, media and SQLite catalog provenance now pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
